decisions.reason: The dietary supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy consumer health business and fits its strategy of broadening the consumer portfolio.
This skin and hair supplement was recently launched in pharmacies within an established line and is cheap to keep while it builds sales.
The joint health supplement extends the Trivital brand and targets a large, stable pharmacy segment with an ageing customer base.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche product but needs little investment, so the firm will likely give it more time within the supplement range.

The generic valsartan sits outside the firm's core business, was hit by the 2018 contamination recall, and faces tight price competition and reputational risk, so leaving it off the market is the likely choice.
